summary: The agent implements a solid temporal split, extensive feature engineering, and a well-regularised deep learning model. However, it makes a critical error by sorting the test set and overwriting the original submission IDs with an arbitrary sequence, which will cause evaluation to fail. Additionally, computing lag and rolling features after splitting the data corrupts the initial rows of the validation and test sets by stripping them of their historical context.
